name: Runemaster: Zenith resets on Manastorm stage transfer (#13679)
contract: Issue #13679: Runemaster Zenith (712325, 45 s RecoveryTime) stayed on cooldown after a Manastorm stage
transfer while every other cooldown reset. The stage transfer calls Player::RemoveAllSpellCooldown(), which
empties m_spellCooldowns and refills only the charge pools of known spells. A base Zenith cast also writes the
Echoes ledger ('core.runemaster.echoes') and spends a charge of the Echoes pool 712389, which a Runemaster
without Echoes of Eternity does not know, so CheckCast still returned NOT_READY and the client was sent the
stale cooldown again. The stage transfer now also clears the ledger, refills 712389 and sends the cleared
cooldown. Casts 59752 (120 s control) and 712325 on floor 1, defeats Taragaman to transfer to floor 2, and
proves both cooldowns reset, the 712389 pool is back to 2 charges and 712325 recasts at once on floor 2.

SETUP: Zenith buff applied on floor 1
SETUP: control spell 59752 is on cooldown
SETUP: Zenith 712325 is on its 45 s cooldown
SETUP: Zenith cast consumed one charge from the backing 712389 pool
Match the native phase 1 Manastorm room
Move to Taragaman in Ragefire Chasm segment 1
SETUP: left entrance protection at the boss
Defeat Taragaman to trigger stage transfer to floor 2
SETUP: transferred to floor 2 and entered its safety bubble
CONTROL: normal cooldown 59752 reset on Manastorm stage transfer
FIX: Zenith 712325 native cooldown reset on stage transfer
FIX: backing Echoes charge pool 712389 restored to 2 charges on stage transfer
FIX: client cooldown state for Zenith 712325 is ready on floor 2
SETUP: floor-1 Zenith aura cleared before floor-2 recast
FIX: recast Zenith 712325 immediately on floor 2 well inside its 45 s cooldown
FIX: Zenith 712325 cast succeeded on floor 2 (Echoes ledger no longer blocks CheckCast)
FIX: floor-2 Zenith 712325 aura applied
Leave the Manastorm run
